changelog: Backtest sessions can now carry an optional strategy (backtest_sessions.strategy_id, nullable FK to strategies, ON DELETE SET NULL) -- picked from a new 'Strategy (optional -- adds a pre-order checklist)' dropdown on the New Backtest form. A session with none selected behaves exactly as every pre-v3.23.0 session does.

When a session's strategy has active 'gate' variables, the order ticket now shows a pre-order checklist before submitting -- same checked/total score and 'Only X/Y rules met. Place order anyway?' override-confirm UX the live journal's own pre-trade checklist already uses, just scoped to the backtest ticket. A session with no strategy, or a strategy with no active gate variables, submits in one click exactly as before -- the checklist step is skipped entirely, not just hidden.

The checklist's aggregate answer is recorded as gates_passed (new TINYINT(1) column: 1 = every gate checked, 0 = overridden with at least one unchecked, NULL = no checklist applicable) on backtest_pending_orders for a limit order and carried to the trades row on fill, same carry-through convention planned_risk_pct/balance_at_day_start already use for a limit order's own risk tier. A market order records it directly on fill. gates_passed is never enforced -- it only records; gates_passed/gates_passed-adjacent logic never changes gates_passed or any existing live-trade behavior.

This is plumbing for a later release's FSA Gate 1 structure indicator (a Pine-script-ported BOS/CHoCH engine that will pre-fill/compare against the trader's own gate-1 answer) -- no structure-reading logic, chart overlays, or badges ship in this release.
release_notes: Migration 2026_10_09_0001_add_backtest_strategy_gates.sql: guarded ALTERs (information_schema check + PREPARE/EXECUTE, MySQL 8.4 has no IF NOT EXISTS for ADD COLUMN/ADD CONSTRAINT) adding backtest_sessions.strategy_id + its FK (fk_bts_strategy, ON DELETE SET NULL -- deleting a strategy must not delete or block deleting sessions/trades that merely referenced it for the checklist), backtest_pending_orders.gates_passed and trades.gates_passed (both TINYINT(1) NULL, meaningful only for source='backtest'). BacktestController.php: createSession() validates an optional strategy_id belongs to the user (silently NULL otherwise, same 'fall back, don't reject' treatment as default_leverage/drawdown_type); new getActiveGateVariables() helper (role='gate' AND is_active=1, same filter trades.js's own openChecklist() already uses) feeds sessionSummary()'s new strategy_id/gate_variables fields; placeOrder() accepts optional gates_passed, passed through fillPosition() (market) or the pending-order insert (limit); evaluateBar()'s limit-fill branch carries a pending order's own gates_passed into fillPosition() on fill; getResults() now also selects/returns gates_passed per trade for round-trip visibility on the Results page API. js/backtest.js: new btOpenChecklist()/btToggleCheck()/btUpdateCheckScore()/btChecklistProceed() (bt-prefixed to avoid colliding with trades.js's own same-shaped functions in the shared global scope); btSubmitTicket() is now the entry point (opens the checklist when applicable, else calls straight through) and the former body is renamed btSubmitTicketConfirmed(gatesPassed). pages/backtest.php: new Strategy dropdown on the setup form (Session card) and a new #bt-checklist-popup, reusing the live journal's own .checklist-popup CSS class, own bt- prefixed ids throughout. tools/ui-harness: new drive-v3230.mjs (10 assertions) against two new stateful mock sessions (26 market-order checked/override cases, 27 limit-order carry-to-fill, both a 'gated' scenario with 2 mock gate variables) plus existing fresh session 20 reused unmodified to confirm a strategy-less session still submits in one click; stubs/api.php gained strategy_id/gate_variables on every session response and gates_passed carry-through in backtest_place_order/mockAdvance(). drive.mjs, drive-v3223.mjs, drive-v3225.mjs, drive-v3226.mjs, drive-v3227.mjs, drive-v3228.mjs, drive-v3229.mjs and drive-v32210.mjs all pass unmodified. backtest_engine.php self-test: 104 passed, 0 failed (unaffected -- no pure-math changed). php -l and node --check clean on every changed file; duplicate-name scan clean. Next up: the FSA Gate 1 structure-indicator engine itself, built on top of strategy_id/gates_passed landing here.
